description: This file 'usp_register.c' implements a comprehensive set of functions for registering and managing data model elements in a USP device. It includes functions to register parameters (constant, supported lists, database-backed, secure, read-only, auto-initialized, alias), objects (with create/delete validation, add/remove callbacks), events, operations (synchronous and asynchronous), groups of parameters, vendor hooks, and other data model constructs. The code handles registration of parameters with different access rights, unique keys, object instances, vendor-specific callbacks, and groupings for efficient access. It also manages special parameters like aliases, supports nested objects, multi-instance objects, and registers operations with input/output arguments, refresh mechanisms, and vendor hook integrations.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_CoreVendorHooks(vendor_hook_cb_t * callbacks)
methods.description: Registers core vendor-specific callback functions used by the data model. It replaces existing hooks if provided, only during the VENDOR_Init context.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Param_Constant(char * path,char * value,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a parameter that has a fixed, unchanging value, useful for version info, support options, etc.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Param_NumEntries(char * path,char * table_path)
methods.description: Registers a parameter representing the number of entries in a table, with the value calculated automatically.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Param_SupportedList(char * path,const enum_entry_t * enums,int num_enums)
methods.description: Registers a parameter containing a comma-separated list of enumeration options, typically for supported features.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_ReadWrite(char * path,char * value,dm_validate_value_cb_t validator_cb,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a read-write parameter persisted in the database. Supports validation, notification callbacks, and default values.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_Secure(char * path,char * value,dm_validate_value_cb_t validator_cb,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb)
methods.description: Registers a password or sensitive parameter that is stored but read back as empty string.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_SecureWithType(char * path,char * value,dm_validate_value_cb_t validator_cb,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a secure parameter with explicit type, similar to the above but allowing type flags.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_ReadOnly(char * path,char * value,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a read-only parameter persisted in the database.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_VendorParam_ReadOnly(char * path,dm_get_value_cb_t get_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a vendor-exposed read-only parameter, non-persisted, with a get callback.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_VendorParam_ReadWrite(char * path,dm_get_value_cb_t get_cb,dm_set_value_cb_t set_cb,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a vendor-exposed read-write parameter, with get/set callbacks, not stored in the database.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_GroupedVendorParam_ReadOnly(int group_id,char * path,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a read-only vendor parameter as part of a group for efficient bulk access.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_GroupedVendorParam_ReadWrite(int group_id,char * path,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a read-write vendor parameter as part of a group for bulk get/set.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_ReadOnlyAuto(char * path,dm_get_value_cb_t get_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a read-only parameter whose value is generated automatically at creation time.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_ReadWriteAuto(char * path,dm_get_value_cb_t get_cb,dm_validate_value_cb_t validator_cb,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a read-write parameter initialized dynamically at creation time.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_Alias(char * path,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb)
methods.description: Registers an alias parameter that also registers it as a unique key within the data model table.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Object(char * path,dm_validate_add_cb_t validate_add_cb,dm_add_cb_t add_cb,dm_notify_add_cb_t notify_add_cb,dm_validate_del_cb_t validate_del_cb,dm_del_cb_t del_cb,dm_notify_del_cb_t notify_del_cb)
methods.description: Registers an object (multi-instance) with create/delete validation and callbacks.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Object_UniqueKey(char * path,char ** params,int num_params)
methods.description: Defines the set of parameters that form a unique key for a multi-instance object, supporting compound keys.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Object_RefreshInstances(char * path,dm_refresh_instances_cb_t refresh_instances_cb)
methods.description: Registers a callback to refresh all instances of an object and its descendants.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_GroupedObject(int group_id,char * path,bool is_writable)
methods.description: Registers an object that is part of a parameter group, supporting bulk get/set.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_SyncOperation(char * path,dm_sync_oper_cb_t sync_oper_cb)
methods.description: Registers a synchronous operation (RPC) with a string path ending in '()'.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_AsyncOperation(char * path,dm_async_oper_cb_t async_oper_cb,dm_async_restart_cb_t restart_cb)
methods.description: Registers an asynchronous operation with start/stop callbacks, can be restarted and managed concurrently.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_AsyncOperation_MaxConcurrency(char * path,int max_concurrency)
methods.description: Sets maximum concurrent invocations of an async operation.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_OperationArguments(char * path,char ** input_arg_names,int num_input_arg_names,char ** output_arg_names,int num_output_arg_names)
methods.description: Associates input and output argument names with an operation, used for descriptions and documentation.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Event(char * path)
methods.description: Registers an event element (notification) in the data model, expects path ending in '!'.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_EventArguments(char * path,char ** event_arg_names,int num_event_arg_names)
methods.description: Defines argument names for an event, used for data reporting.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_GroupId(char * path,int group_id)
methods.description: Assigns a group ID to a command or event, used for organizing vendor interactions.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_GroupVendorHooks(int group_id,dm_get_group_cb_t get_group_cb,dm_set_group_cb_t set_group_cb,dm_add_group_cb_t add_group_cb,dm_del_group_cb_t del_group_cb)
methods.description: Registers group-level get/set/add/delete vendor callbacks for bulk operations.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_SubscriptionVendorHooks(int group_id,dm_subscribe_cb_t subscribe_cb,dm_unsubscribe_cb_t unsubscribe_cb)
methods.description: Registers vendor callbacks for subscription management on a parameter group.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_MultiDeleteVendorHook(int group_id,dm_multi_del_cb_t multi_del_cb)
methods.description: Associates a vendor callback for bulk deletion of objects.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_CreateObjectVendorHook(int group_id,dm_create_obj_cb_t create_obj_cb)
methods.description: Associates a vendor callback for creating objects.

methods.name: int ValidateAliasParam(dm_req_t * req,char * value)
methods.description: Validates the value of an Alias parameter, ensuring format, current value, and uniqueness.

methods.name: int ValidateParamUniqueness(dm_req_t * req,char * value)
methods.description: Checks that a parameter value is unique within its parent table to enforce uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: ValidateParamUniqueness
methods.description: Checks that a parameter value is unique within its parent table; retrieves all instances, compares existing values, and flags conflicts.

ctags.name: USP_REGISTER_Object
ctags.pattern: /^int USP_REGISTER_Object(char *path, dm_validate_add_cb_t validate_add_cb, dm_add_cb_t add_cb, dm/
ctags.signature: (char * path,dm_validate_add_cb_t validate_add_cb,dm_add_cb_t add_cb,dm_notify_add_cb_t notify_add_cb,dm_validate_del_cb_t validate_del_cb,dm_del_cb_t del_cb,dm_notify_del_cb_t notify_del_cb)

ctags.name: usp_err_bad_scope_str
ctags.pattern: /^static char *usp_err_bad_scope_str = "ERROR: Function must be called from within context of VEND/
